caption:
I turned LinkedIn infographic design into a reusable skill.

The animated infographic attached to this post was made with it.

It is called linkedin-infographics, and it works in both Claude Code and Codex.

Give it a topic, LinkedIn post, transcript or rough notes. The skill turns the source into five useful beats, lets you choose one of four wireframes, then animates and checks the final asset.

It handles:

Story structure.
Layout selection.
Visual population.
Motion and timing.
Export and QA.

The final package includes the GIF, cover image, caption, editable content and QA report.

I am turning the complete build into a YouTube tutorial.

Comment “SKILL” and I will share linkedin-infographics.
